question: Yet another illegal action by Türkiye has seen the publication of the Presidential Decrees of 15 August establishing two marine parks in the Aegean and Eastern Mediterranean. These parks encroach on areas of Greek sovereign rights and Greece’s continental shelf.

The Presidential Decrees establish two marine parks: One stretching between Limnos and Samothrace and another in the Eastern Mediterranean, which cuts Kastellorizo off from Rhodes completely. With this move, Türkiye continues to assert the illegal position that the islands have no rights beyond a six nautical mile limit and insists on drawing a median line between the mainland coasts of the two countries.

By establishing these marine parks, supposedly to protect the marine environment, Türkiye is seeking to enforce its claims against Greece and to enshrine in law the so-called ‘Blue Homeland’ doctrine, a doctrine that has been condemned by the European Parliament.

In view of this, can the Commission answer the following: What action will it take against Türkiye in response to the illegal act of declaring ‘Turkish marine parks’ in areas extending beyond Türkiye’s territorial waters, with these parks violating Greek and European sovereign rights since they include areas of the Greek continental shelf and EEZ, and even territorial waters over which the Greek islands have jurisdiction under UNCLOS?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (14.10.2026) The EU has consistently underlined that the sovereignty, sovereign rights and jurisdiction of all Member States must be respected, in full respect of international law, including the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

In this context the EU has repeatedly called on Türkiye to act with restraint, refrain from any unilateral action liable to increase tensions, and to commit itself unequivocally to good neighbourly relations, international agreements and the principle of peaceful settlement of disputes.

Abstaining from unilateral actions that violate international law and the sovereign rights of Member States is essential to ensure a stable and secure environment in the Eastern Mediterranean. It is also essential for developing a cooperative and mutually beneficial relationship between the EU and Türkiye.
The EU will continue to raise matters of concern through the appropriate political and diplomatic channels, to defend the interests of the EU and its Member States, and to uphold regional stability.
